title: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Refilings: Charge by the Form the Backing Term Is Written to Back
content:
A refiling form charge is added to the refiling fee of a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) reinstatement refiling, which replaces a certificate whose SR-26 was transmitted for a cancellation of its since-reinstated backing term. It follows the certificate form the backing term is written to back. That form is the financial responsibility filing recorded on the Owner Auto Policy term or the Named Non-Owner Policy term.

| Term recorded as written to back | Refiling form charge |
|---|---|
| an FR-44 | 10.00 |
| an SR-22 | 2.00 |
| none | none |

**Positive and negative cases (hypothetical)**

- **Recorded FR-44.** A Named Non-Owner Policy term recorded as written to back an FR-44: 10.00.
- **Recorded none.** An Owner Auto Policy term recorded as backing none: no form charge, whatever certificate the refiling is for.
